context: Aoi reaches her due date; calm anxious talk with Mei.
purpose: Pregnant friend close to birth talking with experienced mom.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: It's finally almost time. The baby's coming soon.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost breathless with anticipation. Warm but taut — excitement and nervousness sitting right at the surface. Careful pacing, like she's holding something fragile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Are you all set? Everything ready?
lines.style: Gentle lean in. Warm inquiry with the cadence of someone who's been through this. Soft, steady — asking not to prompt anxiety but to ground it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Small, honest exhale. Quiet vulnerability — not apologetic, just real. Slight pause after 'but,' like she's checking herself for how much to admit.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Everyone feels that way. It's normal.
lines.style: Soft, knowing reassurance. Not dismissive — the tenderness of someone who remembers her own fear. Slight warmth in the tone, like a hand on her shoulder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I can't seem to stop worrying.
lines.style: Quiet, a little helpless. Slower pace. The tone of someone who's tried to logic her way out of it and given up. Slight trailing-off, like the worry continues beyond words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Trust your body. You're going to be fine.
lines.style: Firm but tender. Light conviction in the opening. Not advice-giving — anchoring. Steady eye-contact level delivery, calm and sure without being dismissive of her fear.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, almost surprised by the relief of being heard. Soft, genuine. The small sigh of tension finally finding somewhere to rest.
